remarks: Discover the allure of Westport's sought-after waterfront enclave, where coastal charm meets everyday convenience. Stroll or bike through scenic streets and take advantage of three private beaches-complete with Adirondack chairs, picnic spots, kayak racks, and grills-perfect for soaking up summer days. Just minutes from Saugatuck's vibrant dining scene, the train, and Main Street shopping, this location has it all.You'll also enjoy access to Longshore Country Club, offering golf, tennis, a sailing school, and a waterfront restaurant. Inside, Island Way welcomes you with sun-filled, stylishly furnished living spaces featuring high ceilings, custom finishes, and wood-burning fireplaces for cozy evenings. The chef's kitchen shines with professional-grade appliances and a generous marble island, ideal for gatherings. Upstairs, four bedrooms-including a tranquil primary suite with a spa bath-offer the perfect retreat after a day of coastal adventures. Available September 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
